description: This file is a shell script used for telemetry and diagnostic operations in a network device, including configuration management, remote command execution, cleanup, and telemetry data collection and upload.

methods.name: getEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device, either via dmcli or via ifconfig/rpcclient depending on the device type.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of the erouter interface via dmcli.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address of the erouter interface via dmcli.

methods.name: getControllerId
methods.description: Uses SNMP to retrieve controller-related IDs such as ChannelMapId, ControllerId, VctId, and vodServerId.

methods.name: getRFStatus
methods.description: Uses SNMP to retrieve RF status parameters like downlink power, transmit power, and SNR.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes the DCM response JSON file, reformats it, and extracts telemetry configuration.

methods.name: scheduleCron
methods.description: Sets up or updates the cron schedule for telemetry data collection based on configuration.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Ensures SSH server (dropbear) is running for remote access.

methods.name: clearTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Clears telemetry configuration and marker files.

methods.name: generateTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Generates telemetry configuration files from input JSON.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file to allow reinitialization.

methods.name: sshCmdOnArm
methods.description: Executes a command on the ARM device via SSH, with retries.

methods.name: dcaCleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup before reboot or log upload, including remote cleanup if supported.
